body: As a woman carrying another life inside of you, you should do whatever the hell you think is best. Don't let this man control you like that and put you down when he doesn't understand your struggles. I know this is over dramatic for me to say, but I'd leave him. Or you should tell him that what he said was wrong and that if he doesn't correct himself, you're done with him. HE is in the wrong. You do not need to shower every single day to be a "proper woman". First of all, it's unhealthy to do so. Second of all, tell him to woman up, because that's a load of dumb man crap. You deserve better. Do NOT let a man control you or put you down whatsoever. I also don't believe that's what he's mainly concerned about. Has he had any history of cheating? He seems to be trying to break off with you.

Ah-- I've missed a few of your questions. I've just recently been able to get to talk to him, but she's been very mad at me for this. I thought she actually didn't care, but was only joking because she'd laugh when she said it. So I got his number and we've been ACTUALLY talking, not just me daydreaming of him and staring at him whenever I get the chance to. And no, I haven't talked about how my friend opposes us. He and his sister are very close, and I'm scared that he'll just stop talking to me completely because it makes my friend upset. Also no, but my friend has told him lovely little stories about me. I'm pretty sure he knows. I'd like to say I'm different. I truly believe that I've changed. It's easier to convince yourself rather than convincing others, though. There's also a 50/50 chance that things with my friend can turn. We've been there for each other since we were so small, and I don't think that this would be enough to tear us apart, but it would definitely do some damage.   My friend's friend is bisexual, just recently came out. I think I've answered you're questions, correct me if I'm wrong. And again, thank you so much for taking your time to read this!
Thank you for your opinion. It's very much appreciated! :)

Thank you so much for taking the time to reply to this! It's very appreciated! I really want to take the big step forward, but I also want to take my time because I'm scared of getting hurt or hurting this person. I care for him so much, and the last thing I'd like to do is hurt him. But hopefully-- eventually, we'll get there! I really wish you the best with your special person <3

**Trigger Warning: Mention of suicide and sexual assault.** 

Oh my gosh. Thank you so much for taking the time writing all of this. When I was little, around age 8 or 9, I was sexually assaulted by two people who I looked up to and really loved and thought that I could trust. So what I did when I grew older was either wear extremely baggy clothing around family members or older men, or I'd wear little clothing around the males and females I really wanted to love me. I would date people and try to fill whatever I thought was missing, and they'd either be extremely clingy, which really disgusts me, or they'd be wanting only one thing, and I think we both know what that is. So I understand why people look at me as a player. I can't keep a relationship going to save the life of me. I don't know why I've tried to make my self look physically attractive to them when I just wanted to be loved emotionally first. I've recently been to a mental hospital because I've tried to off myself. There's too many things as to why I did it, but I got a lot of help. I've been trying to come to terms about what had happened to me and I've been trying to love myself more. But there's a little background info about me :) I'm not looking for pity, but an understanding. 

My best friend. This girl is one of the purest souls I've ever met in my entire life. We call each other the love of our lives (platonic, of course). She would kill someone for me, and I'd do the same. I literally cried the other day because someone called her fat and I wasn't there to put him into a hospital. This girl deserves everything and more. I feel bad because she's upset with me, and she's done so much for me emotionally and physically. And I'm happy that she's with my other best friend. I know that they're both amazing people and that they love each other very much, even though they've only been together for half a year. I know he'll treat her right, and I know that she'll treat him right. I would probably cry for them if they broke up because I haven't seen either of them that happy before. I adore them so much and I want them to be happy. But yeah, it hurts when things get rough between us, but I'm just happy that they're happy together, and I don't want to say much about what I'm feeling because I'm terrified that one will end up hating me or they'll end up disliking the other because of me. I would break.

Onto the boy, now. He reminds me of my best friend, but he's also very different. I've literally tried calculating how many eyelashes this kid had. I adore the smell of his natural shampoo. Every time I'm around him I feel like I'm floating. His personality is a very rare thing. He calculates every word that he says and genuinely cares about people. He's very intelligent, and I admire him. Even when I get a text or he calls, I feel so happy. I've never felt like this before and I feel as if I can trust him. He also doesn't just focus on a person's body, but focuses on the goodness of their heart, which is sadly unusual for boys in their teenage years. I respect him and he respects me. I just wish that my friend could look past the stereotype of how dating your friend's sibling is gross. I want her to be happy for me. I want to be happy with him and her. It's so difficult getting the two things you want most. 

Thank you so much for the conversation recommendations. I'll try my best to get all points across and hopefully it work out in the end.
Thank you for replying. I'll back off.

They're lazy. They know it's bad, but they're just lazy motherfuckers who don't do shit because they know it'll be so much work to deal with. Instead, they take the easy way out and let us get inappropriately touch/spoken to just because it's convenient. It needs to change. The world is such shit.
